result:
I wrote `component.html` in the folder. I haven't opened it in a browser, so the layout is unchecked.

- **Layout:** the page sits on white inside `#component` at 1280px wide. Content is one centered column with a 48px top margin. The "Requests" heading is in Unbounded Light capitals. The message is centered below it, with "No requests yet" as the title and the line under it in muted text.
- **Primary button:** "Create a Request" is a 44px ink pill. DESIGN.md allows one primary button per screen, so I put it only in the centered message. The top-row slot on the right is empty.
- **Import link:** "Import from a spreadsheet" is a plain text link in the accent colour. It has a 44px tap area.
- **Tokens:** `tokens.css` is inlined, trimmed to the tokens the page uses, so the file is self-contained. All colours, sizes and spacing come from tokens, with no raw hex values in the component styles.
- **Fonts:** the folder has no font files, so Unbounded and Archivo fall back to system fonts.
